channel.title: SoldMike Blog
channel.description: Real results, market notes and plain answers for home sellers and buyers in Vaughan and the GTA.

item.title: Pre-Construction or Resale: Which Fits Your Timeline?
item.description: Resale lets you move in within months. Pre-construction spreads out your deposit and gets you a brand-new home, but closings can be delayed for years. Here's how to choose, and what to check before you sign with a builder.

item.title: 5 Low-Cost Fixes That Pay Off Before You Sell
item.description: Paint, lighting, small repairs, a deep clean and a tidy front yard cost little and change how buyers see your home. Here's what to fix before you list in Vaughan, and what to skip.

item.title: Closing Costs for Buyers in Vaughan: The 2% Rule and Land Transfer Tax
item.description: What buyers pay on top of the down payment in Vaughan: the 2% rule, how Ontario land transfer tax is worked out at real price points, what changes in Toronto, and the first-time buyer refund.

item.title: How Much Do You Need for a Down Payment in Ontario?
item.description: The 5%, 10% and 20% down payment rules in plain English, worked out for real Vaughan price points, plus the closing costs and deposit you need on top.

item.title: Offer Nights Explained: How to Win or Sell in a Multiple-Offer Market
item.description: What an offer night is, when sellers should hold one, what a bully offer is, and how buyers can compete without overpaying for a mistake. A plain guide from a Vaughan broker.

item.title: What It Really Costs to Sell a Home in Vaughan
item.description: Commission, HST, legal fees, your mortgage payout and the prep work buyers notice. Here's every cost of selling a home in Vaughan, and how to work out what you actually walk away with.

item.title: How We Sold a Markham Home $210K Over Asking in 6 Days
item.description: 82 Highland Park Boulevard in Grandview, Markham sold for $1,210,000, $210,000 over asking, in 6 days with five-plus offers. Here is the pricing and offer-night strategy behind it, and what it means if you're selling.
